name_reason: Name is fully compliant: data_fd2_ prefix (game global), chapter domain, ch26 is a meaningful chapter domain ID (chapters 01-30, NOT an address residue), descriptor end_scene_char_pos_x_table accurately reflects content (per-char world-tile X positions for chapter 26's end scene) and data type (_table). No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix equal to 0x522d6 or any data address).
purpose: Chapter 26 end-scene character X-position table: one world-tile X coordinate per party char slot 0..15, used to place the cast at scripted positions in the chapter 26 end scene.
logic_summary: const uint8[16] read only by fd2_chapter_26_end @ 0x24E80. The Watcom prologue copies the 16 bytes (4 dwords) onto stack scratch (var_1c), then passes the scratch pointer as arg1 (pos_x) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro, which indexes it by char slot to set each char's pos_x. Paired with the pos_y table @ 0x522E6 and facing table @ 0x522F6 (arg2/arg3 of the same call).
element_semantics: Element i = world-tile X coordinate for party char slot i (i in 0..15). Memory bytes: 0E 0F 0F 0E 10 0E 0F 10 0D 0E 0F 10 11 0E 0F 10 (decimal 14,15,15,14,16,14,15,16,13,14,15,16,17,14,15,16). Values cluster in tile X range 0x0D..0x11 (13..17), coherent placement coordinates matching the paired Y table (6..12).
